name: How long does it take to fix a main sewer line blockage?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to fix a main sewer line blockage?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time it takes to fix a main sewer line blockage varies significantly depending on the nature and location of the problem. A straightforward clog might be cleared in a few hours using snaking or hydro-jetting. If the issue involves significant tree root intrusion, a collapsed pipe, or other structural damage, the repair could take much longer, potentially a full day or even multiple days if excavation and pipe replacement are necessary. A plumber will provide an estimated timeline after diagnosis.
acceptedAnswer.description: Fixing a main sewer line blockage can take a few hours for simple clogs or multiple days for complex issues like pipe damage requiring excavation.
